test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The Namesake was written by Jhumpa Lahiri.

options.text: Jhumpa Lahiri has written The Namesake.
Jhumpa Lahiri was writing The Namesake.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The Namesake was written by Jhumpa Lahiri."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "Jhumpa Lahiri" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was written" to "wrote" (past simple active).
 
• Ensure the object "The Namesake" follows the verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Jhumpa Lahiri wrote The Namesake."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Jhumpa Lahiri written The Namesake." – Incorrect tense ("written" should be "wrote").
 
• **Option 2: **"Jhumpa Lahiri has written The Namesake." – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"Jhumpa Lahiri was writing The Namesake." – Incorrect aspect (past continuous instead of past simple).
